programs.title: Love It or List It UK
programs.desc: Kirstie and Phil visit Caterham in Surrey to help Ruth and Ken settle their debate over their three-storey town house; Ruth is tired of the kitchen and lounge being on separate floors, but Ken's worked hard transforming their home and wants to stay.

programs.title: Love It or List It UK
programs.desc: Jacqueline and Renee are at loggerheads over their extended six-bed home in Stockport; after a previous renovation didn't solve their issues, Renee is ready to list; but Jacqueline believes that the house can work, if only Kirstie can convince Renee.

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Ranjit bought her little home when she was a bachelorette; fast-forward 20 years later, and the walls are closing in on her family of three. Ranjit and husband Nabeel are in desperate need of a reset, but they don't know how to start. Kortney and Kenny guide them through a massive declutter, turning a man cave into a teenage-friendly space, making room for living, and calming the chaos.

programs.title: That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer
programs.desc: Books, bold style, and big ideas collide! Lara Spencer challenges the teams to design a library study - 70s Revival vs. Parisian Chic. The teams pull out all the stops including painting original artwork and restoring vintage furniture.

programs.title: That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer
programs.desc: Sunshine sets the stage as Lara Spencer pits two teams against each other in a sunroom design showdown. Grandma-core faces off with Brownstone Classic, bringing ambitious plans, creative DIYs, and more plants than you can count.
